name: Kaiyue Wen
bio: Stanford CS PhD student (with Tengyu Ma and Percy Liang) studying LLM optimization and pretraining science, known for the river-valley view of WSD schedules, Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers, Hyperball, and RNN vs Transformer retrieval limits.

name: Yifan Zhang
bio: Princeton PhD candidate and Princeton AI Lab Fellow working on LLM architectures, attention and positional encodings, RL for LLM reasoning (Cumulative Reasoning, Diagram of Thought) and agentic AI, with prior stints on NVIDIA Nemotron and ByteDance Seed.

name: Alex L. Zhang
bio: MIT PhD student who introduced Recursive Language Models (RLMs) and works on KernelBench, VideoGameBench and GPU MODE kernel competitions.

name: Michael Y. Li
bio: Final-year Stanford CS PhD student (advised by Noah Goodman and Emily Fox) working on pushing more of the LLM stack into learning, e.g. RL-trained KV-cache garbage collection, self-play pretraining and quasi-Monte Carlo test-time scaling.

name: Keller Jordan
bio: OpenAI pretraining researcher who created the Muon optimizer and the NanoGPT and CIFAR-10 training speedruns, and studied variance across neural network training runs.

name: Zhijian Liu
bio: Assistant professor at UC San Diego (Z Lab) and NVIDIA research scientist working on full-stack efficient AI, including efficient LLM inference, speculative decoding (DFlash) and quantization (ParoQuant).

name: Maksym Andriushchenko
bio: PI leading the AI Safety and Alignment group at ELLIS Institute Tuebingen and MPI-IS, known for adversarial robustness (Square Attack, RobustBench), LLM jailbreaks and agent harm benchmarks.
affiliation: ELLIS Institute Tuebingen / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

name: Jianlin Su
bio: Moonshot AI researcher who invented Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE/RoFormer) at Zhuiyi Tech and works on optimizers (Muon/MuonClip), attention and LLM architecture, writing the Scientific Spaces (kexue.fm) blog.

name: Florent Krzakala
bio: Full professor at EPFL leading the IdePHIcs lab, known for statistical-physics approaches to machine learning, high-dimensional inference and learning theory.

name: Jitendra Malik
bio: Berkeley EECS professor and computer vision pioneer known for normalized cuts, shape contexts and R-CNN, now working on robot learning and embodied perception.

name: Samuel Sokota
bio: Researcher at OpenAI (CMU PhD with Zico Kolter) working on reinforcement learning and test-time compute in imperfect-information games, including magnetic mirror descent and Stratego-scale decision-making.

name: Sadhika Malladi
bio: UCSD assistant professor (ex-Microsoft Research postdoc, Princeton PhD with Sanjeev Arora) using mathematical insight into deep learning to design efficient fine-tuning and training algorithms such as MeZO.

name: Shreya Shankar
bio: Data-systems researcher (Berkeley PhD, now CMU) building LLM-powered data processing systems such as DocETL and studying evaluation and operationalization of ML/LLM pipelines.

name: Neel Nanda
bio: Leads the Google DeepMind mechanistic interpretability team; creator of TransformerLens and known for work on grokking, induction heads and sparse autoencoders.

name: Rulin Shao
bio: UW PhD candidate (Pang Wei Koh, Luke Zettlemoyer) and visiting researcher at Meta working on retrieval-augmented LMs, reasoning retrievers (ReasonIR) and RL training signals (Spurious Rewards).

name: Aaron Roth
bio: Penn professor working on differential privacy, algorithmic fairness, game theory and calibrated/conformal prediction; co-author of The Ethical Algorithm.

name: Alec Helbling
bio: Georgia Tech ML PhD student (advised by Polo Chau, NSF GRFP) studying diffusion and flow-based generative models and their internal representations, known for ManimML and visual ML explainers.

name: Aleksa Gordić
bio: LLM pretraining engineer and educator (The AI Epiphany), former DeepMind research engineer, core llm.c contributor, YugoGPT creator and tech lead on Essential AI's Rnj-1 models.
affiliation: Essential AI (Rnj-1 tech lead); ex-Google DeepMind, Microsoft

name: Anirudh Goyal
bio: Mila PhD (Yoshua Bengio), formerly Google DeepMind, researching modular and inductive-bias architectures, LLM reasoning, metacognition and test-time compute for agents.

name: Randall Balestriero
bio: Brown University assistant professor (ex-Meta FAIR postdoc with Yann LeCun) working on the theory and practice of self-supervised learning, spline views of deep networks and JEPA-style world models.

name: Valentin De Bortoli
bio: Google DeepMind research scientist (CNRS researcher on leave from ENS Ulm) working on the theory and methods of diffusion models, including diffusion Schroedinger bridges and discrete/simplex diffusion.

name: Alexander Panfilov
bio: ELLIS/IMPRS-IS PhD student in Tübingen (Jonas Geiping, Maksym Andriushchenko) working on AI safety and red-teaming LLMs, including jailbreak threat models and capability-based scaling laws for red-teaming.

name: Ryan Greenblatt
bio: AI safety researcher, formerly chief scientist at Redwood Research and now at METR, known for AI control and alignment faking in large language models.

name: Larry Dial
bio: ML engineer at Open Athena working on the Marin open model project, multiple-time world-record holder in the modded-NanoGPT training speedrun, ex-AWS.

name: Will Brown
bio: Leads applied research at Prime Intellect, building open-source agentic RL infrastructure (verifiers library, Environments Hub); formerly Morgan Stanley ML research, Columbia PhD in algorithmic game theory.

name: Samip Dahal
bio: Co-founder of Q Labs, a research lab working on data-efficient learning algorithms beyond gradient descent, including the NanoGPT Slowrun benchmark, looped models and zeroth-order pretraining.

name: Micah Carroll
bio: OpenAI alignment researcher (Berkeley PhD with Anca Dragan and Stuart Russell) known for Overcooked-AI human-AI coordination work, AI-induced preference manipulation, and chain-of-thought monitorability.

name: Anton Lozhkov
bio: Machine learning engineer at Hugging Face working on open code LLMs and datasets such as StarCoder2, The Stack and FineWeb-Edu.

name: Evan Hubinger
bio: Alignment researcher at Anthropic known for 'Risks from Learned Optimization', Sleeper Agents, and alignment-faking and reward-tampering studies.

name: Daniel van Strien
bio: Machine Learning Librarian at Hugging Face working on datasets, OCR and open ML tooling for libraries and cultural heritage, and a BLOOM contributor.

name: Tomek Korbak
bio: OpenAI safety researcher (ex-UK AISI, Anthropic) working on chain-of-thought monitorability, pretraining with human feedback and RL from human preferences.

name: Paul Christiano
bio: Founder and director of the Alignment Research Center, former head of safety at US CAISI and former alignment lead at OpenAI, known for RLHF, iterated amplification and eliciting latent knowledge.
affiliation: Alignment Research Center / OpenAI Foundation board

name: Xi Wang
bio: Johns Hopkins researcher working on Bayesian deep learning, probabilistic inference and optimization.

name: Jacky Kwok
bio: Stanford CS PhD student (Azalia Mirhoseini, Marco Pavone) developing scalable verifiers for agents and robots, including RoboMonkey, LLM-as-a-Verifier and CoVer-VLA.

name: Benjamin Recht
bio: Berkeley EECS professor working on optimization, control and machine learning methodology, known for matrix completion, random features and the arg min blog.

name: Quanquan Gu
bio: UCLA computer science professor working on machine learning theory, RL and LLM alignment methods such as self-play fine-tuning (SPIN) and SPPO.

name: Christopher Potts
bio: Stanford professor of linguistics and computer science working on NLP, interpretability, and LM programming (DSPy) and evaluation.

name: Zhean Xu
bio: DeepSeek engineer and core contributor to the DeepGEMM and DeepEP open-source GPU kernel libraries for FP8 GEMM and MoE expert parallelism.

name: Zihao Ye
bio: Creator of FlashInfer (MLSys 2025 best paper), a kernel library for LLM inference serving; UW PhD (Ceze/Chen) now building GPU kernels and agent-driven kernel compilers (CAKE) at NVIDIA.

name: Thibault Formal
bio: Member of technical staff at Linkup (formerly Naver Labs Europe) and lead author of SPLADE, working on learned sparse retrieval (SPLADE-v3, SPLATE, SPLARE, SPARSEUP).

name: Varun Singh
bio: Pretraining lead at Arcee AI who led pretraining of the open-weight Trinity MoE model family.

name: Geoffrey Irving
bio: AI safety researcher, cofounder and chief scientist of Resolution, formerly chief scientist at the UK AI Security Institute and lead of alignment teams at DeepMind and OpenAI, known for AI safety via debate.

name: Varun Srivastava
bio: ML researcher and engineer who set several Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records (Muon speedups, multi-token prediction, batch size scheduling) and builds RL environments for Prime Intellect.

name: Markus J. Buehler
bio: MIT professor leading the Laboratory for Atomistic and Molecular Mechanics, working on AI for materials science, generative and graph-reasoning models, and multi-agent scientific discovery systems.

name: Joel Niklaus
bio: Hugging Face researcher (formerly Stanford) known for legal NLP datasets and benchmarks such as MultiLegalPile and LegalBench, now working on LLM evaluation and data.

name: Edgar Dobriban
bio: Penn statistician working on theory of machine learning, high-dimensional statistics, conformal prediction and uncertainty quantification, and LLM robustness.
affiliation: University of Pennsylvania (Wharton Statistics and CIS)

name: Leo Gao
bio: AGI alignment researcher and EleutherAI cofounder, known for GPT-Neo, the Pile, lm-evaluation-harness, reward model overoptimization scaling laws, scaling sparse autoencoders to GPT-4 and weight-sparse circuit interpretability.

name: Jasper Dekoninck
bio: ETH Zurich PhD student (Martin Vechev) behind MathArena, working on LLM evaluation, contamination detection (ConStat) and rating systems (Polyrating).

name: Cong Wei
bio: Waterloo PhD student advised by Wenhu Chen working on multimodal generation and understanding, including MoCha talking-character video generation, UniVideo and the MANTIS multimodal model.

name: Michael C. Mozer
bio: Senior staff research scientist at Google DeepMind and longtime CU Boulder professor working on cognitively informed machine learning, human learning and memory optimization, and recurrence in transformers.
affiliation: Google DeepMind; University of Colorado Boulder

name: Richard Cornelius Suwandi
bio: CUHK-Shenzhen PhD candidate working on Bayesian optimization, Gaussian process kernel discovery with LLMs and evolutionary coding agents for algorithm discovery; co-founder of AIDDA.

name: Charlie O'Neill
bio: Co-founder/CTO of Parsed (acquired by Baseten) who now co-leads model training at Baseten's Base Labs; ANU/Oxford researcher on sparse-autoencoder interpretability, post-training and continual learning.
